questions.question: God told Israel that land in the promised land could not be sold for good. What reason did He give?

answers.text: The land belongs to the LORD
The land belongs to the priests
The land belongs to the king

questions.question: Before the Sabbath year, God promised to bless Israel in the sixth year. What would the land produce?
God said Israelites must not be sold as slaves. What reason did He give?

answers.text: They are His servants He brought out of Egypt
There are too few of them to spare
Their fathers made a vow at Sinai
